message: The 404 code 'invoice.missing' is listed on routes 'deleteInvoice', 'getInvoice', 'sendInvoice', 'updateInvoice', which also answer the derived notFound code, so they have two 404 codes.
fix: Add errorRoles: { notFound: invoice.missing } on the member node of the collection that lists 'invoice.missing', or allow seampact/not-found-role on the catalogue entry with a reason.
